title: Leo Learns Table Manners: The No-Slurp Adventure!

lines.text: Dinner time at Leo's house! Steaming bowls of delicious vegetable soup on the table!
lines.caps: Dinner time at Leo's *HOUSE! | Steaming bowls of delicious *VEGETABLE | soup on the *TABLE!

lines.text: SLUUURP! Leo dipped his spoon and slurped so loudly, the walls shook!
lines.caps: *SLUUURP! Leo dipped his spoon | and slurped so loudly, the *WALLS | *SHOOK!

lines.text: Soup splashed on his shirt, and breadcrumbs tumbled onto the floor like confetti!
lines.caps: Soup splashed on his *SHIRT, | and breadcrumbs tumbled onto the *FLOOR | like *CONFETTI!

lines.text: Dad smiled gently and said, Welcome to the Royal Knight Banquet, Sir Leo!
lines.caps: Dad smiled *GENTLY and said, | Welcome to the *ROYAL | Knight Banquet, Sir *LEO!

lines.text: Royal knights place their soft linen napkin across their lap like a secret banner!
lines.caps: Royal knights place their *NAPKIN | across their lap like a *SECRET | *BANNER!

lines.text: They blow softly on each spoonful, chew with quiet closed lips, and say please!
lines.caps: They blow softly on each *SPOONFUL, | chew with *QUIET lips, | and say *PLEASE!

lines.text: Leo tried the Royal Knight style—suddenly eating soup felt like an elegant adventure!
lines.caps: Leo tried the Royal Knight *STYLE— | suddenly dinner felt like an *ELEGANT | *ADVENTURE!

lines.text: Kind table manners show love to the chef and keep dinner peaceful for everyone!
lines.caps: Kind manners show *LOVE | to the chef and keep dinner *PEACEFUL | for *EVERYONE!
